jq.name: OCR callbacks reuse the external plugin
discovery starts only after complete book OCR
entry, discovery, gaps and metadata-boundary joins retain explicit fan-in
scoped evidence cannot accept model-selected books
jq.expr: [.config.tools[].integrations.plugins[]? | select(.input_fields != null) | .input_fields | any(.name == "run_id" and .fill == "correlation" or .fill.source_field == "source_run_id") and any(.name == "book_hash" and .fill.source_field == "book_hash") and any(.name == "path" and .fill.source_field == "path")] | all

jq.name: pipeline agents have no transcript or raw database access
jq.expr: [.config.tools[] | select(.tools_id != "shelf-tools" and .tools_id != "shelf-research-tools") | .datastore.enable_defra_query == false and .built_ins.enable_session_history_tool == false] | all

jq.name: native joins are separate from filesystem callbacks
all task stages allow book and chapter parallelism
